textPreview: The earliest collider analyses treated dark matter production as a contact interaction between dark matter and quarks, a model-independent framework that breaks down at the LHC, where the partonic collision energy routinely approaches or exceeds the mediator mass and the effective-operator expansion is no longer self-consistent.
